ClickUp's Cloud Platform team builds scalable, secure, and cost-efficient AWS infrastructure, with a heavy focus on Amazon EKS, that stays ahead of product and enterprise growth. As a Senior Software Engineer, you leverage AI to design, build, and operate the compute, networking, and infrastructure-as-code foundation that powers ClickUp for millions of users.

We are hiring a UX Designer who loves turning real user problems into clear, safe and well-tested designs, and who wants to shape how healthcare professionals work with AI every day.

Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App (web and mobile), we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.
Design is central to this vision. Our users are care professionals working with clients, not behind a desk. Every flow we build needs to be simple, fast and safe to use. And because the Attendi App is being certified as a medical device (MDR), we don’t just design what feels intuitive, we prove that users understand and use it as intended.

This isn’t about making it as easy as possible to order a pizza. It’s about how a care professional can receive AI-generated advice safely, and make sure they check what matters before they rely on it.

Your Role
As a UX Designer at Attendi, you will:

• Translate user research into user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs for the Attendi App.

• Work closely with our UX researcher, who uncovers user needs in the field, and turn those insights into the right solution.

• Visit care organisations to test your designs with healthcare professionals: does this solution fit the problem we observed?

• Design for safety in an AI product: identify where users could misuse or over-trust AI output, and design features that mitigate that risk.

• Run usability studies as part of our MDR certification, through simulations, observation or A/B tests, and document what you tested and learned.

• Work in two lanes: fast shipping of new features, and careful, well-documented work on our medical device track.

• Work closely with the product owner, developers and our compliance team to get designs into production.

• Help mature our design system in Figma.

You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

• 2-4 years of experience as a UX or product designer in a product team, working in sprints.

• Experience with B2B SaaS products.

• You balance a startup pace with taking a step back to research and test before going to production.

• Strong Figma skills.

Construction is the slowest paid industry, with contractors waiting around 96 days to get paid. Construction software has historically been built for General Contractors. We’re building for the subcontractors actually doing the work.

These businesses are managing millions of dollars on spreadsheets, printouts, ERP reports, and a whole lot of manual work to get paid.

Every project has different billing requirements, different deadlines, and different paperwork. Miss something, and payment can get pushed out another 30 days.

Subcontractors deserve software built specifically for them. That’s why we built Siteline .

A Note On How To Reach Us

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar - it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem - helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Where You’ll Work:

• As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.

• With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.

What You’ll Do:

• You’ll build your own pipeline. Consistent, personalized outreach to government agencies that administer grant programs is the foundation of your results. You see it as the best way to sharpen your craft, because earning a response to a cold email or call is the hardest part of selling. Marketing and BDR-sourced leads are a welcome bonus on top of your own efforts, never a substitute for them.

• You’ll own the full sales cycle and its results, carrying each opportunity from first conversation through a signed deal.

• You’ll run discovery that goes past the surface request, listening for the mission, constraints, and outcomes each organization is working toward, reading both the people and the process, and shaping solutions that fit what they’re trying to achieve.

• You’ll deliver clear, compelling demos and proposals that connect Foundant’s grant management solutions, including our purpose-built AI, to the results your prospect cares about.

• You’ll drive government decision-making instead of waiting on it. • You’ll independently lead larger, more complex opportunities, including multi-stakeholder and multi-product deals, through public-sector procurement requirements, committee reviews, and security reviews.

• You’ll help lead the growth of our Government segment, bringing your public-sector experience to new agencies, programs, and approaches, and sharing market and buyer insights with your segment director and cross-functional partners to shape how we expand.

• You’ll think critically about how to position Foundant for each buyer and how our internal teams work together, so you know who to involve, when, and why.

• You’ll use AI to work smarter, from account research to outreach to proposal preparation, and you’ll apply critical thinking to how you use it: checking its outputs, protecting data, and keeping your own judgment in the lead.
